strategyThesis: By Q4 2027, enable two prioritized guest journeys with trusted cross-property identity and consented data, while deferring property-by-property app rebuilds. Decide by end of October between a central data foundation and property-level pilots on a thin shared layer, with a 31 December evidence gate to validate value before committing to a platform.
